scope: Editorial decisions for the seven SSVEP follow-ups of this round, cards 8 to 14 of /topics/new-ssvep-frequencies/: the cross-spectral scorer (card 8, queue row 21), the coherence and eigenvalue heads (card 9, row 12), the pooling of CCA’s per-harmonic statistics on BETA and Wearable-102 (card 10, row 32), filter-bank CCA with shorter windows and fewer electrodes and the CPU component measurements (card 11, rows 33 and 30), the harmonic gap (card 12, row 15), the fixed decay weighting (card 13, row 14) and the rising harmonic weights (card 14, row 20). Its own manifest: it amends no earlier review and changes no released file. new-ssvep-frequencies-update.json keeps its bytes (D28); the new file, ssvep-followups-update.json, supersedes that file’s card 8 status entry. Every figure is read from the audited aggregate of its study, pinned by SHA-256 here and bound by that study’s release approval and reviews, through the five block modules (blocks_xspec.py, blocks_eigen.py, blocks_pooling.py, blocks_practical.py, blocks_weights.py), which select named fields and declare what they leave out. Nothing was re-run: no model was loaded, no score recomputed and no network used.

approval.basis: The owner’s decision D14 in chat on 2026-10-28, recorded in owner-decisions.json: publish this round’s reviewed aggregates, among them the seven SSVEP studies (rows 12, 14, 15, 20, 21, 32, 33). Each study’s release approval approves an aggregate handoff and leaves website publication to the site; publication on the site rests on D14. Defaults stated to the owner and not objected to: the short answer gains one sentence (D22); thread predictions stay on card 4 and the new cards state only their prespecified criteria (D23); the CPU component timings sit in card 11’s details as warm single-thread component measurements, never summed, with no host label (D25); new-ssvep-frequencies-update.json keeps its bytes and the new file supersedes its card 8 status entry (D28). Carried over: the commenter is not named (D6). Gate A1: the cross-spectral aggregate was copied read-only and matched to its SHA-256. Local build only: no deployment, GitHub, Hugging Face or Zenodo action.
previewDefaults: Placement: cards 8 to 14 of /topics/new-ssvep-frequencies/; cards 1 to 8 keep their numbers and anchors; card 8 becomes a result card, read from this file, and the released file keeps its status entry.

Each study block keeps its own source interval: 2,000 paired person draws with seed 20261015 for cards 8, 9, 10 (BETA) and 11; 2,000 with seed 20261020 for card 10 (Wearable-102), conditional on the fixed source heads; 20,000 with seeds 20261021 and 20261022 (card 12), 2026102201 and 2026102202 (card 13), 2026102501 and 2026102502 (card 14).

A level several cards share prints its interval on its home card only and names that card elsewhere: interval_home in shared_estimates is card 5 or card 7 for a level released on 2026-10-20, else the first card of this release that gives an interval (card 9 for the harmonic sum on BETA); intervals_differ_by_card marks the rows whose cards give different intervals.
Card 12’s primary family uses Bonferroni-adjusted 99.44% intervals over nine comparisons and card 13’s margin test a 90% interval; no other interval is adjusted.
Thread predictions stay on card 4 of the released file (D23); the commenter’s figure and name are absent from the file, the page and this manifest.

Names: the plan’s name key, site names first and export codes second; one set of scores, one primary site name; aliases are listed in the name key (“joint CCA”, JOINT-TOP on card 9 and J on card 12, is an alias of “CCA (no training)” and of card 7’s “matched CCA”); where the plan’s key conflicts with a released name, the released name stands (CCA-RAW stays “CCA (no training)”, card 7’s CCA stays “matched CCA”).
Counts: no new page, dataset, model or leaderboard row.
decisionsOfThisReview: Values: every level and contrast is its study aggregate’s own double, through the block modules; units stay fractions, squared-correlation score units for card 12’s G and R, milliseconds for the CPU components. The export audit re-derives every figure from the pinned research files without the block modules.
Release status is read from each study’s release approval and reviews, never from an aggregate’s own frozen status field.

Reused comparators: CCA, the shared ridge scorer, the cropped-spectrum match and the channel-energy average equal card 5’s released levels, the cross-spectral readouts card 8’s, the eigenvalue heads and harmonic sum card 9’s, card 10’s Wearable-102 CCA card 7’s level; each is labelled with its card.
The handoffs are context and never a copy source; each is pinned here with the hash its release approval binds and its queue row names.
Credits: BETA’s and Wearable-102’s released records from new-ssvep-frequencies-update.json; FBCCA (Chen et al. 2015) from the site’s method profile.

Context: the receipts and records the harmonic-gap and timing approvals bind, and the reviews and record behind the engineering disclosures, are pinned under contextPins, each checked bound by a pinned record; queue row 30 names the parent handoff that asked for the CPU component timings, pinned beside the timing handoff.

releaseRecord.decision: Publish the seven SSVEP follow-ups of this round as their audited aggregates, cards 8 to 14 of the new-SSVEP-frequencies page, outside every leaderboard.
releaseRecord.rights: BETA keeps its released record: CC BY 4.0, cohort aggregates only, with participant consent described for noncommercial scientific research. Wearable-102 keeps its released record: CC BY 4.0, cohort aggregates only. Filter-bank CCA is credited to Chen et al. 2015; the code that ran is the project’s own SciPy realisation, and no code or weights are distributed.
releaseRecord.researchRelease: Each study’s release approval approves an aggregate handoff and binds its aggregate, protocol and reviews by SHA-256; website publication rests on the owner’s decision D14.
releaseRecord.binding: This record approves the served file the export audit names.

notPublished: Per-person, per-fold, per-rotation, per-seed and per-window values of any kind, predictions, scores, features, fitted heads and the sealed run files: only cohort levels, paired contrasts with their intervals, gap statistics, decision-change shares, check counts and CPU component medians are published.
Per-frequency values of any kind, including the reference check’s candidate frequencies: the check is published as counts.
The cross-spectral per-seed MLP accuracies, the canary accuracies and the random-pairing accuracies of cards 8 and 9.
The fixed-decay retrospective gap-to-gain ratio table and its dry reconstruction.

All-trial decision counts: the harmonic-gap decision changes on BETA held-out are published as shares of the 11,200 decisions; the Wearable-102 decision changes and the fixed-decay and rising-weight transitions are not published.
The harmonic-gap Delta means and the margins against the strongest joint-CCA distractor.
Run times of whole evaluations and audits, memory and process identifiers; the CPU-time readings of the component measurements and every host, processor, system and runtime label.
Predictions from the comment thread on cards 8 to 14: each new card states its prespecified criteria only, and the thread’s prediction stays on card 4 of the released file.
The handoffs, protocols, freezes, receipts, reviews and approvals themselves: each is pinned by SHA-256 in the release manifest and checked by the export; several carry private storage paths.
